---
title: "Na Masjidaan Mehfoz Rayiyaan Na Mehrab Aye Lyrics 2022"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Other"
poet: "Najfi"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Na Masjidaan Mehfoz Rayiyaan Na Mehrab Aye
Wich Sajday Qatal Karna Baniya Sawab Aye.
Likh Lainday Jay Wasiyat Haye Aakhri Nabi Di.
Zahra De Ghar Choon Uthdi Maiyyat Na Aynj Ali Di.

2
Ona Mariya Jinna Layi Kafi Kitab Aye.
Kalma Go Yaad Rakh Laein Kirdar Syeda Da.
Pyasa Zibha Na Karna Sardar Syeda Da.
Jiday Babay Ne Qatil Nu Kita Serab Aye.

3
Kofay Diyaan Galiyaan Wich Aj Soag Aye Murtaza Da.
Aawein Gi Fair Kofay Le Dard Karbala Da.
Lang Jana Be Rida Taun Jiwein Koi Khuwab Aye.
Zainab Ne Wain Paya Nahin Maa Da Qatal Bhuliya.

4
Assi Jan Gaye Haan Baba Jiwein Chad Ke Taun Aye Chaliya.
Nahin Veraan De Sir Bachney Na Koi Hijab Aye.
Jehray Parhday Ne Ali Un Wali Ullah Wich Namaz Aye.
Matam Jinna Layi Najfi Iss Dunya Te Aizaz Aye.

5
Karday Ne Duawaan Oh Karo Mustajab Aye
Noha Khuwan Party Ch Faiyaz Party Sialkot.
Matami Sangat
Anjuman-e-Sipah-e-Ahl-e-Bait Sialkot

_, front, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = front.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1].split('\\n#', 1)[0]
for section, nums in [(roman, '12345'), (body, '۱۲۳۴۵')]:
    stanzas = [s.strip().splitlines() for s in section.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
    assert ''.join(s[0] for s in stanzas) == nums
    assert [len(s)-1 for s in stanzas] == [4,4,4,4,1]
print(\"Verified 17 paired verses across five stanzas.\")

item.text:
Reconstructed all 17 verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi and verified that `romanLyrics` matches the five source stanzas in order and verse count. The Punjabi grammar supports correcting the original Urdu label to `pa-Arab`.

I rendered the ambiguous Roman “Haye” as `ہائے` and retained the closing recitation credits in YAML comments. Only the selected lyric was edited.
